note: Sessions are split in time order: the first 60% train, the next 20% choose each model's settings, the last 20% are scored once, refitting every 10 sessions on earlier data only. Confidence ranges resample whole sessions, because predictions from the same day are correlated. A model is promoted only if it beats both the time of day and the time and position benchmarks with a range above zero, is calibrated (error under 5 points), helps in both high and low VIX sessions, and adds economic value. Otherwise the page shows the historical frequency and says no model beat it.
